name: jm-full-trial
description: JudgeMySite: submit a site for a live Full Trial and wait for the verdict, then scroll the verdict surfaces into frame. The worked example — every step matches on-screen text, never a ref.

steps.comment: The submit button is ABSENT from the a11y tree until the URL field is non-empty — it renders disabled. Hence it is matched here, after the fill, not before.
The long phase: capture, examination, synthesis. Polls every 5s and keeps sampling evidence, so the minutes spent here are not blind.
Bring the verdict surfaces into frame so the tape carries them: FIRST ORDER band, then the charges with their receipts.
